item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod zlog gsang ba yang snying gi bskang ba thugs dam dgyes mchod
item.coloph: de ltar rtsod bzlog (zlog) gsang ba yang snying giyi dam rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bon skyong la/ rgyun du dgos pa'i cha lags su (lag tu) bstan pa/ thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug sgo rigs rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis (gyi) slob ma/ 'bru rigs sngags 'chang shes rab 'od zer gyis/ rta lo'i lo gsar rgyal gyi zla bar/ 'bor long rma ri dgon du sbyar bas/ sgrub rgyud rig 'dzin mchog gi sa thob nas/ bkra shis bde legs yongs la 'phel gyur cig/
